title: Rehang two detached grommets on a full-size shower liner
instruction: Two hooks on the shower liner have come loose. Rehang the liner properly without taking the whole curtain down.
setup: A 1.8288 by 1.8288 m PEVA liner hangs between shower returns on a 1.93 m rod at 1.978 m. Two adjacent center grommets start off their hooks. The arms share the tabletop on the upper deck, and the liner hangs into the lower bay.
scoring: 0.35 per repaired grommet physically supported by its assigned hook. Full credit for the stable, released liner with all twelve attachments engaged for one second.
fidelity: A full-length sheet with distributed physical mass, articulated fold hinges and force-bearing seams.
scores: Two-level bay, seed 0. Dream-1 score 0.00. Scripted demo score 1.00.
context: A full-size shower liner remains hanging from ten hooks. Reattach the two loose center grommets without taking down the sheet.
reset_notes: Start with grommets 6 and 7 off the lower hook returns. Reset and settle the entire gravity-loaded sheet with all ten original grommets still threaded. Use seed 0 and zero jitter.
